name: 35W USB-C PD Fast Charging Adapter
description:
USB-C Power Delivery adapter, jo compatible devices ko fast charging provide karne ke liye design kiya gaya hai. Compact packaging aur portable design ke saath daily use ke liye suitable.
Key Features:
35W rated output (box ke mutabiq)
USB-C port
PD fast charging support
Compatible phones aur devices ke liye
